messages.text: The harbor-bot container exits with code 137 a few minutes after it starts. The Docker host is dock-02.
137 means the process was killed, probably out of memory. I will check the container limit and the kernel log.
Memory cgroup out of memory: Killed process 40117 (node) total-vm 1840212kB, anon-rss 262908kB
The limit is 256 MiB (268435456 bytes) and the node process reached about 257 MiB resident. The limit is too small for the bot's cache.
Raise it to 512m in compose/harbor.yml. Do not touch the other services in that file. And add a healthcheck on /healthz every 30s.
edit compose/harbor.yml: mem_limit 512m; healthcheck GET /healthz interval 30s retries 3
bash: docker compose -f compose/harbor.yml up -d harbor-bot
harbor-bot runs with 512m and is healthy after 3 minutes. Only harbor-bot was recreated.
